lede: Thrive is a weekend for women 16 and older to step out of the rush, open the Word together and remember who God is. Two old Hebrew words shape everything we're building toward.

words.name: Yirah
words.text: Reverent wonder. The kind of awe that stops you, puts things back in proportion and reminds you that God is bigger than whatever has been taking up all your attention.

words.name: Anag
words.text: To take real pleasure in something. It's the word behind Psalm 37:4. Delight isn't a feeling we work up. It's what happens when we see how good God actually is, and find out he delights in us too.

verse: Take delight in the Lord, and he will give you the desires of your heart.
